The '''Lorardians''' were the natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lorardia]]. Their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was one of the [[Mistryl Shadow Guard|Mistryl]] worlds [[Lorardian slaughter|destroyed]] by the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]].
